recommended_positioning_paragraphs: Constructive Access is a unified reference and executable workflow for identifying target properties of hidden dynamics under specified physical access. It connects exact obstructions and distinguishing experiments to independently checkable certificates, calibrated statistical decisions, and declared physical resource budgets. The practical contribution is that a scientist can follow one argument from apparatus assumptions to a defensible conclusion, including an explicit reason to change the experiment or abstain.

The strongest specific mathematical candidates remain the reversible-gate current coefficient and its scoped activation and information-order results, together with the prescribed-cost filtered certificate and the worked model classifications. Finite linear equivalence, predictive representations, adaptive design, optimal recovery, and testing by betting already have substantial prior literature. The unified release makes those foundations and the specific results usable together; historical priority and physical validation of the proposed constructions remain questions for specialist review and experiment.
